Package internshipPlacementManagementSystem

Class Application

java.lang.Object
internshipPlacementManagementSystem.Application
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class Application
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable
Application class created by Student applying to an Internship opportunity Must be approved by CompanyRep and confirmed by Student to allow successful Internship allocation Can be withdrawn with CareerCentre staff approval at any time
